notable_absence.finding: This changelog names several service/feature areas (Eventing Functions API, XDCR/Replications API, GSI/Query Indexes API, App Endpoints, CMEK, Billing, Free Tier, Network Peering, Private Endpoint Service) purely as 'Added the X API. Use this API to...' one-line summaries. None of these entries describe a service-to-service architectural dependency (e.g. nothing says 'the Eventing Functions API depends on the Data Service') - they describe REST capability additions, not runtime service topology. No dependsOnService evidence found on this page for eventing or XDCR.

cross_component_finding: This is overwhelmingly a pure historical changelog: each entry is a one-line 'Added/Updated the X API' summary linking out to the Management API reference guide (out of scope) and to a handful of already-covered or out-of-scope concept pages (eventing-overview.md, cluster-rbac.md, cmek.md, alert-integration.md, manage-log-streaming.md). The single entry with genuine ontology content is the August 2026 Database Roles API addition, which explicitly ties into the existing Advanced Access Credentials / cluster-access-credential-type family already promoted from prior rounds - everything else is thin by nature of being a changelog, consistent with the batch instructions' expectation for reference/catalog pages.
